clauses.clause: When this enchantment enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
clauses.evidence: Trace: the ETB ask offers [opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant, opp_relic, opp_charm] (opponent's nonland permanents only: no lands, nothing of yours); the pick moves battlefield -> exile '(until card leaves the battlefield, then back to the battlefield)'. The return is never exercised. Packs PASS: banishing_light_returns_when_it_leaves.json (Banishing Light destroyed: the 2/2 returns to the battlefield under seat 1's control) and banishing_light_exiles_while_it_stays.json (the exiled artifact stays exiled across a full turn cycle). Wrong twins fail.
